acceptanceCriteria: red-before-green and diagnose-before-fix block a live L1 source write while the active task holds no proof or diagnosis, in any phase
ci-actions-pinned, file-naming and bug-rows-immutable judge real L1 writes
the firing test silent list shrinks by the landed write-probe rules
diagnosis: Reproduce: node --test consumer-enforcement-firing-l1.test.ts reports 17 silent L1 rules; 11 are write probes whose blocking reply lists workflow-gates and writes-within-plan but not the target (the engine reports every finding, so the target never evaluated to a finding). Root causes: (1) core/red-before-green and core/diagnose-before-fix real judging gates on implementationBegan(task), but SPEC 4.12.3 says a live L1 source write is judged on evidence in any phase. (2) core/ci-actions-pinned judges only marker files, never a real workflow. (3) core/file-naming reads only sample.txt markers, never a real path. (4) core/bug-rows-immutable is marker-only though checkBugRowsImmutable exists. (5) core/arch-module-mapped, arch-boundaries, arch-public-entry, arch-no-cycles are marker-only and the shared probe write-preproof has no import, so no real judging exists at L1. (6) Probe defects: write-ts-phantom imports a relative path (never phantom), write-package carries no two packages of one capability.
